coordinated_activities.activity: Sleeping, resting for the early cafe opening shift
Washing face, brushing teeth and changing into barista work clothes (bathroom free, as Member 1 is still out on the night shift and Members 3 and 6 are asleep)
Quick breakfast with tea, and packing a clearly labelled lunch box for the shift
drive the EV to the cafe for the opening shift (no other member is using the electric vehicle at this time)
Working the barista opening shift: setting up, pulling espresso shots, serving the morning rush and cleaning down the machine
drive the EV back home from the cafe with a box of leftover food to share
Eating a late leftover-food lunch with Member 1 and labelling the leftover food before storing it in the fridge
Showering and changing out of work clothes (Member 1 is studying in Bedroom 1, so the bathroom is free)
Daily prayer and a quiet moment to reset
Working on design studio coursework on the computer under the desk lamp
Tea and a snack break, checking the tea shelf stock
Cooking her own medically safe dinner using her clearly labelled ingredients; also quickly adding her work clothes to Member 1's shared load of laundry in the washing machine so one load washes both
Eating dinner at the kitchen table together with Member 1, Member 3 and Member 4
Washing dishes and wiping the bench, sharing the kitchen tidy-up with Member 1 and Member 4
Continuing design deadline work on the computer and tidying her desk area
Short walk to the local shop to buy tea and milk
Evening shower and wash-up before bed, timed to finish before Member 1's 21:30 bathroom slot
Evening prayer and quiet reflection
Winding down: reading, checking phone and planning tomorrow's shifts, keeping quiet hours
Sleeping
